# Third-party attribution map

This directory records the upstream sources whose ideas informed Research
Without Theater. They are attribution records, not vendored dependencies,
runtimes, hooks, or callable skill packages.

| Source | Verified source point | License | Relationship |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Yuan1z0825/nature-skills` | Commit `473e8d7b1b918fe37208d3a5e143a3ac9af4c91b` | Apache-2.0 | Conceptual influence only |
| `lennney/stop-that-shit` | Public label `0.2.5`; release page commit `8bc1ac558167121e7f28d9fb0bec05c039952206` | MIT | Conceptual influence only |

The skill instructions, references, examples, scripts, documentation, and
evaluation design in this repository were reauthored for Research Without
Theater. No upstream Guard, hooks, executable enforcement, or runtime
configuration are included. No upstream skill is loaded at run time.

The Nature source does not claim that the installed local copy is identical to
the fixed upstream commit; the commit identifies the remote source examined for
this packaging. The Stop That Shit repository publishes `0.2.5` without a
`v0.2.5` tag. The commit above is the revision linked from its public `0.2.5`
release page.

See [the source record](../docs/sources.md), [Nature notice](nature-skills/NOTICE.md),
and [Stop That Shit notice](stop-that-shit/NOTICE.md).
